courseDetails.title: AI Security Masterclass: Prompt Injection & LLM Security
courseDetails.shortDescription: Build, attack, and secure real-world LLM apps with RAG, tool calling, memory, AI agents, and Python.
courseDetails.longDescription:
Build AI applications that are not only powerful, but secure by design.

In this hands-on AI Security Masterclass, you will learn how to build, attack, and secure modern applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). Using Python and Ollama, you will create a complete AI assistant and progressively add chat, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool calling, persistent memory, autonomous agents, and production security controls.

You will begin by building a local AI chat assistant and exploring why LLM security differs from traditional application security. You will then launch realistic prompt injection attacks, attempt to expose hidden instructions, test role-playing and multi-turn jailbreaks, and experiment with encoded prompt manipulation techniques.

Next, you will build a document-based RAG application capable of answering questions from PDFs. You will see how malicious documents can introduce indirect prompt injection, poison retrieved context, manipulate answers, and undermine trusted knowledge. You will secure the RAG pipeline using source validation, context isolation, sanitization, and enforcement controls.

The course then moves beyond chatbot responses into real application actions. You will build a tool-calling AI assistant with weather, calculator, and email tools. You will test parameter injection and unauthorized tool execution before implementing input validation, least-privilege permissions, destination restrictions, and human-in-the-loop approval for sensitive actions.

You will also add persistent AI memory and learn how attackers can poison stored information to manipulate future conversations. You will protect memory using validation, approval workflows, risk scoring, and safe storage policies.

As the assistant becomes more autonomous, you will build an AI agent capable of planning tasks, selecting tools, and executing multi-step workflows. You will then attempt to compromise its decisions and secure it with permissions, policy enforcement, approval gates, and constrained execution.

By the end of the course, you will combine every defense into a reusable AI Security Gateway that includes:

  • Prompt injection detection

  • Jailbreak filtering and risk scoring

  • RAG security and context sanitization

  • Tool authorization and parameter validation

  • Memory poisoning protection

  • Agent security controls

  • Human approval workflows

  • Output validation and audit logging

Finally, you will package and run the complete secure AI assistant using Docker and connect it to local models through Ollama.

This course is ideal for Python developers, Generative AI engineers, RAG developers, AI agent builders, software engineers, and technical professionals who want practical experience securing real LLM applications.

You will not simply study AI attacks. You will build vulnerable features, exploit them, implement defenses, and verify that those defenses work.

Build it. Attack it. Secure it.

Large language models are impressive, but they often produce outdated, unsupported, or inaccurate answers. Retrieval-Augmented Generation, commonly known as RAG, solves this problem by connecting an AI model to external knowledge sources. Instead of depending only on the model’s built-in knowledge, a RAG application retrieves relevant information from your documents and uses that information to generate a more accurate, grounded response.

Throughout this course, you will learn the complete workflow for building RAG chatbots with Python. You will start by understanding the core architecture of a RAG system, including document ingestion, text extraction, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, prompt construction, and answer generation.

You will build a fully functional PDF chatbot that allows users to upload documents and ask natural-language questions about their content. You will learn how to extract text from PDFs, preserve page numbers, clean document content, create overlapping text chunks, and return answers with supporting citations.

The course also covers text embeddings, vector search, and vector databases such as ChromaDB and FAISS. You will learn how to convert document chunks into numerical vectors, store those vectors, perform similarity searches, and retrieve information based on meaning instead of exact keyword matches.

As your skills grow, you will explore advanced semantic search techniques, including metadata filtering, similarity thresholds, query rewriting, hybrid search, keyword retrieval, and result reranking. These techniques will help you improve retrieval accuracy and build more reliable AI applications.

You will also create a conversational RAG chatbot that remembers previous messages, understands follow-up questions, retrieves fresh evidence for every response, and clearly separates conversational memory from document knowledge. You will add citations, confidence indicators, insufficient-evidence responses, and practical guardrails to reduce hallucinations and unsupported claims.

For the enterprise section of the course, you will build a multi-document enterprise knowledge assistant for departments such as HR, IT, finance, operations, and compliance. You will organize documents using metadata, create department-specific collections, manage document versions, support multiple file formats, and implement role-based access controls.

You will also learn how to evaluate and improve your RAG system using metrics such as retrieval relevance, groundedness, answer relevance, citation accuracy, and response latency. You will build a RAG evaluation dashboard for testing questions, reviewing retrieved sources, identifying failed answers, and comparing different retrieval configurations.

By the end of the course, you will complete a portfolio-ready Enterprise Knowledge and Research Copilot using Python, Streamlit, embeddings, vector databases, and modern generative AI techniques.

¿DESEAS PERSONALIZAR LOS PRODUCTOS DE TU TIENDA ONLINE CON PRECIOS DINÁMICOS?

La personalización de productos con precios dinámicos en una tienda online ofrece importantes ventajas competitivas y mejora la experiencia del cliente. Permite ajustar los precios en tiempo real basándose en diversos factores como la demanda, el comportamiento del cliente y la competencia, lo que puede aumentar los ingresos y la satisfacción del cliente.


Beneficios de la personalización con precios dinámicos:

  • Mayor satisfacción del cliente:

    Al ofrecer precios que se ajustan a las necesidades individuales y preferencias del cliente, se crea una experiencia más personalizada y atractiva, lo que puede aumentar la satisfacción y la lealtad.

  • Incremento de las ventas:

    La personalización puede llevar a precios más competitivos y atractivos para el cliente, lo que puede traducirse en un aumento de las ventas y la conversión.

  • Optimización de ingresos:

    La fijación de precios dinámicos permite ajustar los precios en función de la demanda, lo que puede ayudar a maximizar los ingresos al vender productos a precios más altos cuando la demanda es alta y ofrecer descuentos cuando la demanda es baja.

  • Mejor gestión del inventario:

    Los precios dinámicos pueden ayudar a reducir el exceso de inventario al ajustar los precios para fomentar la venta de productos con baja demanda, liberando espacio para nuevos productos o reduciendo costos de almacenamiento.

  • Ventaja competitiva:

    Al ajustar los precios en tiempo real y adaptarse a las condiciones del mercado, se puede obtener una ventaja competitiva frente a la competencia, atrayendo a más clientes y aumentando la participación en el mercado.

En resumen, la combinación de personalización y precios dinámicos en una tienda online puede ser una estrategia poderosa para mejorar la experiencia del cliente, aumentar las ventas y optimizar los ingresos.


¿QUÉ ES WORDPRESS?


WordPress es un software gratuito o herramienta de gestión de contenidos, también llamado CMS (Content Management System), diseñada para crear y mantener fácilmente un Blog, un sitio Web o una Tienda Online.


WordPress es sin duda alguna, el mejor gestor de contenidos del mundo, y el más utilizado con diferencia, llegando actualmente a superar el 58% de cuota de mercado. Además es de código abierto y completamente gratuito.

Empezó en 2003 como un software para blogs, pero con el tiempo ha evolucionado como CMS completo con el que podemos hacer sitios web corporativos, tiendas online, sitios de membresía, intranets y mucho más.


¿QUÉ ES WOOCOMMERCE?

WooCommerce es un plugin (complemento) de WordPress que permite implementar una tienda online totalmente funcional en una web.

Este plugin incluye todo lo necesario para empezar a vender en línea: Las páginas de tienda, carrito, mi cuenta y finalizar compra, los métodos de pago más utilizados en el mundo (transferencia bancaria, PayPal y Stripe), un sistema para configurar diferentes tipos de impuestos y gastos de envío por zonas, etc.

Por supuesto, también permite la subida de un número ilimitado de productos para su venta, pudiendo añadir su precio, descripciones (una corta y una larga), variaciones del mismo, etc.

En definitiva, WooCommerce es una de las mejores opciones que existen para crear una tienda online.


¿QUÉ ES WOWADDONS?

WowAddons es un plugin de WordPress que permite a los usuarios agregar opciones personalizadas, como campos de texto, menús desplegables, casillas de verificación, etc., a los productos que venden en su tienda WooCommerce. Esto permite a los clientes personalizar sus compras y potencialmente aumentar el valor del pedido al cobrar extra por estas opciones.

Whether you are a student, recent graduate, job seeker or working professional, this course provides practical Business English lessons to help you express your ideas clearly, make a strong first impression and communicate naturally with potential employers.

What makes this course valuable?

This course goes beyond memorising common interview answers. You will explore how professional English is used in real workplace situations, including telephone conversations, video interviews, digital communication, networking and professional introductions.

You will learn how to introduce yourself confidently, use common UK workplace expressions, respond professionally during challenging conversations and demonstrate effective communication skills. You will also discover how to develop your professional image, create an engaging elevator pitch and build meaningful workplace connections.

Practise English Job Interview Questions with Real-World Examples

One of the key features of this course is its dedicated interview preparation section. You will explore what employers look for in suitable candidates, understand common interview expectations and practise responding to realistic interview scenarios.

The course includes 40 multiple-choice interview practice questions, supported by explanations that help you understand the reasoning behind effective answers. These activities reinforce essential Business English principles and help you recognise professional communication techniques.

By the end of this course, you will have a stronger understanding of English job interview communication, workplace vocabulary, professional etiquette and networking skills. You will be better prepared to approach English-speaking interviews, communicate your strengths and make a positive impression on potential employers.

Start building the Business English skills that can support your next job interview and future career opportunities.
